name: Dating 4 Girls
summary:
"Heartbroken Player" is a live action interactive video game. As a "cow and horse" in the company, on the night when the comet arrived, you unexpectedly traveled into a love game. In order to return to the real world before shutting down in seven days, you must complete the "love" task assigned by Police Flower Andy. You thought you were in love with the game characters you created, Mona, Feifei, and Heyi, so easy! However, they repeatedly encountered obstacles. With the help of your best friend Arlo, you step back into the world of girls and discover that the attributes you set at will have a huge impact on their lives. With deeper contact, you finally understand that 'although the characters are virtual, the love between you is real'. In the end, under your influence, the girls unexpectedly broke through the system settings and developed self-awareness. You decided to work together to prevent the game server from shutting down!

Please make your choice carefully!!!
